mapper.sql: W.IRWORD_NO, W.IRVRSN_NO, W.IATT_NO, W.STITLE, W.SHTML, W.STYPE, W.SDEL_YN, W.SSEARCH_TEXT, W.SINS_DT, W.SSYS_ID, W.SHTML_PATH, W.SSEARCH_TEXT_PATH, W.SCLOB_FILE_YN, W.SPATH, A.SNAME AS ATT_NAME, A.SEXT AS ATT_EXT, A.ISIZE AS ATT_SIZE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_REL_WORD W LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON W.IATT_NO = A.IATT_NO WHERE W.IRVRSN_NO = #{relVrsnNo} AND W.SDEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY W.IRWORD_NO
SELECT FROM TB_REL_WORD W LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON W.IATT_NO = A.IATT_NO WHERE W.IRWORD_NO = #{relWordNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REL_WORD ( IRWORD_NO, IRVRSN_NO, IATT_NO, STITLE, SHTML, STYPE, SDEL_YN, SSEARCH_TEXT, SINS_DT, SHTML_PATH, SSEARCH_TEXT_PATH, SCLOB_FILE_YN, SPATH ) VALUES ( #{relWordNo}, #{relVrsnNo}, #{attNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{html,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{delYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{searchText,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{insDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{htmlPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{searchTextPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clobFileYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REL_WORD SET SDEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE IRWORD_NO = #{relWordNo}
mapper.sql: ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, MAX(pl.ICATE_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_CATE, MAX(pl.SGUBUN_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_GUBUN FROM TB_PROM pl GROUP BY pl.ILAW_ID )

sql.if:
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM cur WHERE cur.ILAW_ID = P.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND cur.ILAW_NO >= P.ILAW_NO AND ( cur.SSTART_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(cur.SSTART_DT) IS NULL OR cur.SSTART_DT = '--' OR cur.SSTART_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) AND ( cur.SNULL_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(cur.SNULL_DT) IS NULL OR cur.SNULL_DT = '--' OR cur.SNULL_DT >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE hg WHERE hg.CODE_ID = 'SGUBUN' AND hg.CODE = P.SGUBUN_ID AND hg.USE_AT = 'N' )
AND ( P.ILAW_ID IS NULL OR P.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcd.ILAW_ID FROM lcd WHERE lcd.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT dd.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE dd START WITH dd.SDEL_YN = 'Y' CONNECT BY PRIOR dd.ICATE_NO = dd.IREF ) ) ) AND ( ( P.ILAW_ID IS NULL OR P.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca START WITH ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) CONNECT BY PRIOR ca.ICATE_NO = ca.IREF ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) ) OR P.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm START WITH cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) CONNECT BY PRIOR cm.ICATE_NO = cm.IREF ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT P.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", P.STITLE AS "promTitle", P.ILAW_NO AS "lawNo", W.IRWORD_NO AS "relWordNo", W.STITLE AS "docTitle", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(W.SSEARCH_TEXT, 200, 1) AS "snippet" FROM TB_REL_WORD W JOIN TB_REL_VRSN V ON W.IRVRSN_NO = V.IRVRSN_NO JOIN TB_PROM P ON V.IPROM_NO = P.IPROM_NO WHERE W.SDEL_YN = 'N' AND W.SSEARCH_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(W.SSEARCH_TEXT) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY W.IRWORD_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
